facts.fact: The Department of Basic Education told Parliament's select committee that, under ICASA obligations, 406 of 461 (88%) public special schools had received ICT equipment, connectivity and assistive devices, with 12,180 learner devices and 1,624 teacher devices distributed.
facts.system: ICASA obligations ICT and assistive devices for special schools

ZAF.note: Figure covers special schools only, not a share of secondary schools with internet; no curriculum statement.
